sentences.text: Liaoningornis was a bird genus from the Lower Cretaceous of China.
The only known species is Liaoningornis longidigitus.
Linhai Hou described the genus in 1996 and 1997.
Scientists classify Liaoningornis within the parent group Ornithuromorpha.
This animal lived between 125.77 and 119.57 million years ago during the Barremian to Aptian stages.
While Zhou and Hou (2002) considered Liaoningornis the oldest known member of the Ornithurae, a 2012 re-analysis by Jingmai O'Connor identified it as an enantiornithean similar to Eoalulavis.
